verified_no_change_needed: Six criteria for ratification at RFO FAR 1.405(c) - correct (crosswalk: the old 1.602-3(c) limitations are now six criteria at 1.405(c)).
RFO FAR 1.405(b)(2): HCA ratifies, delegable no lower than the chief of the contracting office - correct.

AFARS 5101.602-3-90 Ratification procedures - still that number; the AFARS was not renumbered to RFO numbering (acquisition.gov AFARS page; AFARS combined 1 Feb 2026). Appendix GG holds the Army delegation levels.
Micro-purchase threshold $15,000; the $18,000 invoice is correctly stated as above it.
SAT $350,000 and the $9,000,000 simplified commercial procedures ceiling at RFO FAR 12.201-1 - match the thresholds table.
Task/delivery order GAO protest floor $35,000,000 for DoD, NASA and Coast Guard (FY2025 NDAA sec. 885) - matches the thresholds table.
DoD justification approval: contracting officer at $10,000,000 or below (DFARS 206.104-71 Table 206-1, Class Deviation 2026-O0017 Rev. 2) - matches the thresholds table.
CDA certification threshold: claims exceeding $100,000 - matches the thresholds table.
Warrant Class III = $10M, $25M, $50M, $100M - matches Army Warranting Program Policy v12 Table 1.

CICA stay trigger (GAO notice within 10 days after award, or 5 days after an offered required debriefing date, whichever is later) and the nondelegable HCA override - RFO FAR 33.105-3(b) text fetched and confirmed.
RFO FAR 33.105-4(a): the contracting officer must immediately notify legal counsel on notice of a GAO protest - exact text fetched and confirmed.
Agency report due 30 days (4 CFR 21.3(c)); GAO decision 100 days, 65 days express (4 CFR 21.9) - correct, and correctly cited to 4 CFR rather than the RFO FAR, which no longer restates them.
10 U.S.C. 3133 severable services crossing fiscal years (recodified from 2410a); 41 U.S.C. 3902 for civilian agencies - correct.
Case 4 internal date arithmetic: mid-September 2026 with sixteen days to fiscal year end is consistent with 14 Sep 2026.
residual_risk: RFO DFARS 215.301-x (enhanced postaward debriefings) and RFO DFARS 233.105-370: the DFARS RFO class deviations are published on acq.osd.mil, not acquisition.gov. 233.105-370 is corroborated by two independent secondary sources; the 215.301 subsection number is not, so that cite was deliberately truncated rather than guessed. Confirm both against Class Deviation 2026-O0026 Rev. 1 and the Part 215 deviation before treating them as verified.

All Korea/LCS/SOFA content rests on 411th CSB study material (Q0254-Q0258), not on a published regulation. Left as drafted with korea-verify-cp; confirm the current SMA cycle, LCS routing and Invited Contractor processing with the Chief, C&P.

Army ratification delegation for an $18,000 action is set by AFARS Appendix GG, which is more restrictive than the FAR floor quoted at case 1 node n6. The scenario states the FAR floor correctly and points to Appendix GG and the Chief, C&P; no local threshold was added.
